tools.name: vara_run_scan
tools.description: Run a live scan of public sources for weak signals on a topic. Searches the selected planes (source categories) over the last sweep_depth_hours for the given keywords and target entities, scores what it finds for novelty, and returns a scan report whose signals each carry their source and retrieval time, plus a scan_id for follow-up calls. The only tool that changes state; it makes live network requests and can take a while.

tools.name: vara_list_scans
tools.description: List previous scans, newest first (metadata only). History is kept in an archive local to the running server instance, so older scans may no longer be listed.

tools.name: vara_get_scan
tools.description: Get the complete report of a previous scan by its scan_id (a unique prefix works too), including the signals it found.

tools.name: vara_query_signals
tools.description: Search the signals collected by past scans. Filter by plane (source category), minimum novelty score, entity, or date range. Set include_veil_hold to also search signals that were held back as too weak (see vara_get_veil_state).

tools.name: vara_get_veil_state
tools.description: Show the Veil: signals Vara judged too weak to pass when first seen, kept on a watch list and re-checked over time. Trajectories show whether a held signal is strengthening or fading. Held signals are unverified — being in the Veil is not a result.

tools.name: vara_generate_fir
tools.description: Turn a scan into a Field Intel Report: a readable intelligence brief built from the scan's signals, with provenance attached. format 'operator_tier' is the full report; 'lightweight' is a short brief.
